definitions.explanation: To use time in a certain way.

examples.japanese: {休日|きゅうじつ}を{家|いえ}で{過|す}ごす。
examples.english: To spend the holiday at home.

examples.japanese: {楽|たの}しい{時間|じかん}を{過|す}ごした。

notes:
{過|す}ごす means to spend time.

COMMON USES:
- {時間|じかん}を{過|す}ごす: to spend time
- {日|ひ}を{過|す}ごす: to spend days
- {夏|なつ}を{過|す}ごす: to spend the summer

DON'T CONFUSE:
- {過|す}ごす: to spend (time)
- {過|す}ぎる: to pass, too much
